title: Effect clips
description: Pick an effect, add a photo of a person and get a short vertical clip of them breathing fire, summoning a storm and more. Runs MiniMax H3 with its official effect embeddings on this computer; a 5 second draft takes about a minute.

values.prompt: embedding:minimaxh3_fire_breath The person in the picture takes a deep breath and breathes a huge stream of fire toward the camera.
embedding:minimaxh3_bullet_time The person in the picture leaps into the air; time freezes mid-jump and the camera circles around them in bullet time.
embedding:minimaxh3_blooming_flowers Flowers bloom and grow all around the person in the picture until they are surrounded by blossoms.
embedding:minimaxh3_four_seasons The seasons change around the person in the picture: spring blossoms, summer sun, autumn leaves and winter snow.
embedding:minimaxh3_kiss_camera The person in the picture leans toward the camera, smiles and blows a kiss.
embedding:minimaxh3_storm_magic The person in the picture calls down a storm; lightning crackles and wind whips around them.
embedding:minimaxh3_truman_show The person in the picture walks forward and touches the sky, which turns out to be a painted wall of a giant film set.

evidence: 2026-10-31: all 10 official minimaxh3_* effect embeddings rendered through the app API on the H3 worker (Ref2VA, 832x480, 124 frames, portrait-woman-studio.jpg, one action prompt each, 65-75 s per clip). Looked at 4 frames each: fire breath, bullet time (jump and freeze; the camera orbit does not show), blooming flowers, four seasons, kiss to camera, storm magic and film set reveal show their effect without artefacts and are offered. Paint explosion, dark magic and spiral rise burn Chinese subtitles into the picture, also with an explicit no-text line, and are left out.

2026-10-31: run 4ab1802e through the app API at the app default (480x832 vertical, 124 frames) with the Fire breath card and portrait-man-front.jpg: 75 s, output 480x832, 124 frames with audio; he breathes a burst of fire, identity holds.

2026-10-31: Sharpen 2x stage added (MiniMax H3 latent upscaler, native ComfyUI node from PR 17412, then 3 refine steps from sigma 0.9035 with the turbo model and the same conditioning), the same stage as previs-to-video; a lazy switch runs it only when on.
